c74object.name: el.expflam~
c74object.digest: Exponential flam and roll generator for click triggers
c74object.description:
el.expflam~ expands an incoming audio-rate impulse into an exponential or logarithmic burst of attacks (a "flam"). When driving a click-responsive sound generator or buffer player, it produces rhythmic flams, ratchets, and rolls. Timing acceleration/deceleration, number of attacks, delay spacing, and per-attack amplitude decay are defined with the setflam message. Up to 16 overlapping flams can sound concurrently.
Inlets
Inlet 1 [Left Inlet] (signal / messages): Trigger click input and control message inlet. Receives clicks to trigger flams, as well as configuration messages.
Inlet 2 [Right Inlet] (signal): Flam gate signal. When connected to a signal, incoming clicks will only trigger a flam if the gate signal is non-zero at that moment.
Outlets
Outlet 1 (signal): Flam clicks output. Emits the generated train of impulses.

inlet.digest: (signal/messages) Trigger click input and message inlet
inlet.description: Receives audio-rate clicks to initiate flams, as well as control messages (setflam, flamgate).
Audio-rate gate signal. When connected, incoming clicks arriving at inlet 1 only trigger a flam if this signal is non-zero.

outlet.description: Outputs the generated series of attack impulses.

method.name: flamgate
method.description: When set to 1, flams are bypassed and incoming clicks pass through directly to the output without expansion. When set to 0 (default), flams are generated.

method.name: setflam
method.description:
Configures the flam profile using a 5-element list: [start_delay_ms, end_delay_ms, attack_count, slope, attenuation].
• start_delay_ms: Spacing between the first and second attack in milliseconds (default: 25.0 ms).
• end_delay_ms: Spacing between the penultimate and final attack in milliseconds (default: 100.0 ms).
• attack_count: Total number of clicks in the flam (range: 2 to 128, default: 8).
• slope: Curvature of the delay progression between start and end delay (negative values accelerate slowly; positive values accelerate quickly; default: -3.0).
• attenuation: Successive amplitude multiplier applied to each attack click (e.g. 0.8 creates an exponential decay; 1.0 keeps flat amplitude; default: 0.8).

method.name: signal
method.description: Non-zero samples arriving at inlet 1 trigger a flam. A signal arriving at inlet 2 acts as a gate allowing or blocking flam generation.
